budget_items.topic: Records Room at Public Safety Building
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Priority #1 of 4 DPW facilities request estimated at $25,000 with no quote, based on the square footage of a room that may become the records room.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Priority #3 of 4 facilities request for $15,000; wood deterioration makes this project more urgent.

budget_items.topic: Building Automation System, Public Safety Building
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Priority #4 of 4 facilities request for $12,000 to replace the unsupported front end controller.
budget_items.quote: building automation system public safety building $12,000.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: FY2017 project request for $15,000 to repair the cracking abutments and bring guardrails up to code.
No priority and no estimate given; reconfiguration could not start before FY2018 at one intersection a year because of constraints of funds; federal funding was an option but a long process.
budget_items.quote: at the earliest the reconfiguration of these intersections would not be until fy2018 with one intersection reconfigured in a year-mainly because of the constraints of funds.

budget_items.quote: federal funding is an option but jack said that was a long process

budget_items.topic: Re-work of the Intl 6-wheel dump truck
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Proposal to re-work and re-configure a 17-year-old snow truck and mount the catch basin attachment at $123,000, extending its life 15 years; the truck would need replacing in FY2018.
